changesets.name: remove-story-import-lint.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/quality": minor
---

### Breaking

- Remove the `tests/support-imports` rule and its module allowlist. Delete the `tests/support-imports` block from your quality config; configs that still name it fail validation. Story kits may import any workspace module; how tests use those modules belongs to testing guidance and review.

changesets.name: starter-quality-setup.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/create-app": patch
---

### Fixed

- Generate apps with the pnpm version used to validate the starter, so setup installs the Quality gate and reaches the initial commit without first provisioning an older pnpm binary.
